[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of tastes found in meals:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sweet: Desserts, baked goods, breakfast foods like pancakes or waffles; sources include sugar, honey, maple syrup, fruits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sour: Found in foods like pickles, sourdough bread, sour candies; sources include acids like lemon juice or vinegar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Spicy: Found in foods like curries, chili, hot wings; sources include hot peppers, cumin, chili powder, ginger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Savory: Associated with umami; found in foods like meat, cheese, mushrooms, soy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Bitter: Found in dark chocolate, coffee, leafy greens like kale or arugula.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Salty: Found in chips, pretzels, meats, cheeses; comes from salt.  
[USER] User requested more information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tastes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Umami: Found in meats, seafood, mushrooms, soy sauce, miso paste.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tart: Found in cranberries, rhubarb, some types of yogurt; similar to sour but less intense.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Astringent: Found in tea, red wine, fruits like apples or pears; can be drying or puckering.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Fatty: Found in meats, dairy products, nuts; described as creamy or rich.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Herbal: Comes from spices like basil, rosemary, thyme; fresh and aromatic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Smoky: Found in smoked foods like meats or cheeses; also from spices like smoked paprika or chipotle peppers.
